title: VIX futures and options January 2028 expiration (SOQ settlement) — the settlement that makes MLK 2028 a covered day rather than a hole, unlike MLK 2027
source: EST: RULE-DERIVED, because no published primary reaches January 2028 and this entry states that rather than implying otherwise. The standing rule — the monthly VIX settlement is the Wednesday 30 days before the following month's monthly option expiration, itself the third Friday of that month moved a day earlier when a holiday intervenes — gives 30 days before Friday 2028-02-18 (the third Friday of February 2028) = Wednesday 2028-01-19. The February anchor is the one already carried by this calendar as proposals/opex-2028-02-18.from-fomc-minutes-2028-02-16.json, and it is re-derived here independently: 2028-01-01 is a Saturday (read off nyse.com/markets/hours-calendars and federalreserve.gov/aboutthefed/k8.htm, both HTTP 200 direct 2026-09-09), so 2028-02-01 is a Tuesday and February 2028's Fridays are the 4th, 11th, 18th and 25th. FEBRUARY IS THE CLEAN ANCHOR MONTH IN BOTH VALIDATIONS THIS CALENDAR HAS RUN — its only US market holiday, Washington's Birthday, is always a Monday and so can never move a Friday expiration (2028-02-21 per NYSE's 2028 column, same fetch) — and against the OCC's own calendar, optionseducation.org/api/expirationcalendar re-fetched direct 2026-09-09 (HTTP 200, 34,871 bytes), the third-Friday rule is 3-for-3 on February (2025-02-20, 2026-02-19, 2027-02-18, each the third Friday minus one). THAT OCC FILE SPANS 2025-01-01 -> 2027-12-31 AND CONTAINS NO 2028 DATE AT ALL, which is why this is an extrapolation and is labelled one. Filed estimate on that extrapolation and on this lane's standing no-self-confirm limit for an event discovered in-sweep. Promotion requires reading a Cboe or OCC primary published closer to the date, never recomputing the rule. Checked 2026-09-09
notes: PROPOSED by the mlk-market-closure-2028-01-17 initial-research adjacency sweep (2026-09-09), at D+2 from that closure and inside its +/-5 corridor, which otherwise held exactly one tracked entry (fomc-blackout-start-2028-01-15) across every canonical event and proposal in the calendar. LOAD-BEARING, and the proposer states exactly how: mlk-market-closure-2027-01-18.md's headline VIX finding is that MLK 2027 fell in an UNCOVERED GAP between two 30-day strips, a regularity it measured at 23/53 years (43.4%) 1998-2050. This session reproduced that computation independently — same 23/53 — and found that 2028 is on the OTHER side of it. Consecutive third Fridays 2028-01-21 -> 2028-02-18 are 28 days apart, not 35, so the strips OVERLAP by two days (2028-01-19 -> 2028-01-21) rather than leaving a five-day hole, and MLK 2028-01-17 sits inside the December-2027 contract's window. This entry is that overlap's near edge. The refusal the 2027 sibling drew from its own case — that 'January has MLK, therefore the January VIX contract is drag-cheapened' is FALSE — is untouched and now rests on a second, opposite configuration rather than one. THIS SETTLEMENT ALSO SITS INSIDE THE FOMC COMMUNICATIONS BLACKOUT: fomc-blackout-start-2028-01-15 (estimate) runs 2028-01-15 -> 2028-01-27, so the SOQ prints on a morning when no Fed official may speak. NOTHING TRADEABLE IS CLAIMED. symbols is empty, no house playbook (S1/S2/E1/S3/S4 + G1) is settlement-keyed or calendar-keyed, and every frequency above is calendar arithmetic rather than a market measurement. The impact tier is inherited, not measured: low matches every other vix-expiration-* entry in this calendar. Proposed as an estimate; estimates widen caution and license no entry.
